{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Count unique patients
num_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(num_patients)"}
